copy: I'm a first-generation QuestBridge Scholar at Tufts. If you're first-gen or low-income and applying to college, tell me where you are in the process and I'll try my best to help.
It costs nothing. Answer a few questions and I'll reply by email.
smallPrint: Your answers are emailed only to me. Please leave out Social Security numbers and financial documents. If you're under 18, feel free to fill this out with a parent, guardian, or counselor. This is personal help from one student. It isn't affiliated with Tufts Admissions or QuestBridge, and I can't promise I'll get to everyone.
